result:
I can't approve this source application. One substantive dispute is still open: the last letter of the first word of the Anna bekhoach attribution on scan 42 (ת or ה). There is also one smaller documentation gap on scan 41. Everything else I checked holds up, apart from the excluded case 1022.

- **The attribution dispute.** Three readings disagree and no human has ruled on it. The full-page audit says **תפלת** (high confidence). The earlier group-3 reviewer also read **תפלת** (medium-high). The dedicated reader for 1019 says **תפלה** (high), and that reading is what's now applied. On the tight crop the last letter has a down-leg ending in a foot, like the tav at the start of the word, so I lean towards ת. I can't settle it, and no human answer exists. Grammar and other editions can't decide it either. The rest of the attribution (רבי נחוניה בן הקנה., its final period, no pointing) is not disputed.
- **The scan 41 gap.** The scan 41 audit left the running heading's pointing and the punctuation shapes in its two citations (ויקרא א׳ י״א. and שמות ל׳.) unresolved. The bundle says a separate audit now covers them, but it gives no path to that record, so I couldn't check it.
- **Everything else** matches the full-page audits plus the resolved adjudications 1016–1019 and 1007/1008. The 1016 and 1017 snippets show the maqafs clearly. I found no substantive difference that isn't accounted for. I ran no hashes and changed no files.
